summary: Huachen AI Parking Management Technology Holding Co., Ltd filed a Form 6-K reporting a private placement of 7,000,000 Class A ordinary shares at US$1.552 per share for total proceeds of US$10,864,000 to certain investors. The transaction closed on July 17, 2026, and shares were issued under Regulation S exemption. This is a routine capital-raising event, not a special situation. No board recommendation, advisor, or structural complexity is noted. As a private placement, it does not constitute an acquisition, divestiture, or restructuring.
